arguments.sql: SELECT table_name, json_agg(column_name ORDER BY ordinal_position) AS columns FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND (table_name LIKE 'autsys_%' OR table_name LIKE 'plugin_%' OR table_name IN ('program_runtime_registry','system_modules_registry','system_runtime_registry')) GROUP BY table_name ORDER BY table_name;
